items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Rex Stewart and a 'genius on the trumpet' (implied to be Jethro De Curtis based on the note), but does not mention a personal interaction or relationship with Jethro De Curtis himself.

ctx.x: He could play anything. I don't know why. This is several guys -- no one -- everyone seems to forget about. There's Rex Stewart. There's another guy was a genius on the trumpet. He really was. I mean I'm not taking anything away from anybody, but you know -- he was just a great guy.
Like Jethroe Smith (PHONETIC) was a great guy. Like Sidney Curtiss (PHONETIC) --
